summary: Death Stranding entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Death Stranding
entries.definitive_edition: Death Stranding Director's Cut on Windows PC

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC Director's Cut at current patch level

primary.why: Director's Cut is the current expanded PC route, with high frame rate, photo mode, ultra-wide support, cross-over content, and upgrade/save-transfer guidance from the original PC version.
primary.how_to_play: Use Death Stranding Director's Cut on PC. Record storefront/build, save transfer state, graphics/upscaling settings, online Social Strand state, Half-Life/Cyberpunk cross-over content, and whether the run is original or Director's Cut.

all_releases.reason: skip: historical route; superseded for normal archive play by Director's Cut unless preserving PS4 launch state.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC port with PC display/performance features.
all_releases.reason: skip: use only if preserving the original PC release before Director's Cut replacement.
skip: good hardware route, but less flexible than PC for archive capture/settings.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded PC route with high frame rate, photo mode, ultra-wide support, and documented cross-over content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Director's Cut is the completeness/fidelity route, but original-release preservation may require the PS4 or original PC version separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document whether saves were transferred and whether original PC/PS4 release-state differences matter to the archive.

settings.title: Death Stranding Director's Cut
settings.summary: 4K with a slightly widened field of view, using a community fix configured deliberately narrowly - only the parts that help a 16:9 screen are enabled, and the ultrawide-specific fixes are left off.

mods.name: DeathStrandingDCFix
mods.note: Community fix. Only the field-of-view multiplier and entity-update fix are enabled; the ultrawide, movie and HUD fixes are deliberately off because they are for aspect ratios this setup does not use.

mods.name: ReShade
mods.note: Installed with the add-ons that conflict with capture switched off.

mods.name: Process Lasso
mods.note: CPU set pinned to the cache-heavy core cluster.

settings.modsNote: HDR correction for this one is still outstanding - unlike Returnal, its native HDR needs work, and that has not been done yet. It is listed here rather than left out, so the gap is visible.
settings.settingsNote: Read directly from DeathStrandingDCFix.ini and ReShade.ini in the game folder.

entries.title: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
entries.definitive_edition: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach on Windows PC at 4K with ultrawide support and an unlocked frame rate

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulation branch.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at 4K with ultrawide and unlocked frame rate

primary.version: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach PC (Steam / Epic Games Store)
primary.why: The PC version, ported by the studio behind several other high-quality PlayStation PC conversions, adds 21:9 ultrawide and 32:9 super-ultrawide support for gameplay AND in-game cutscenes at 4K, plus unlocked frame rates beyond the console targets, the same relationship the first game's PC route has to its PS5 release, and no content is lost.
primary.how_to_play: Play Death Stranding 2: On the Beach on Windows PC. Record storefront/build, resolution/aspect (note if 21:9 or 32:9 is in use), upscaler and frame-rate cap, and chapter/order progress.

all_releases.fidelity: Original launch route at fixed console performance targets.
all_releases.reason: skip: the launch artifact, but no ultrawide and a capped frame rate. Nothing is content-exclusive to it.

all_releases.fidelity: 21:9 and 32:9 support in gameplay and cutscenes at 4K, unlocked frame rates.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest fidelity with the same content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No conflict: the PC release carries the same content with a higher ceiling. Only PS5-native haptics/3D-audio behaviour differs, and a wired DualSense narrows that.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether a run is on the PS5 original or the later PC version, post-launch patches mean the two are not frame-identical.
